cues.en: To understand your sensory input correctly you need to draw on other information, in

cues.en: this case your knowledge about optical illusions.

cues.en: it, you arrive at a wrong conclusion.

cues.en: Flat earthers similarly arrive at the wrong conclusion by failing to decode evidence,

cues.zh: 甚至完全忽略了自身感官所提供的诸多证据。
cues.en: indeed by simply ignoring a lot of evidence that their own senses deliver.

cues.zh: 这些证据关乎社会和科学是如何运转的。
cues.en: This is evidence about how society and science works.

cues.zh: 无论我们是不是科学家，都在不断利用这些证据来指引生活。
cues.en: Whether we are scientists or not, we all constantly use this evidence to navigate life.

cues.zh: 我相信地平论者也不例外。
cues.en: And I am sure flat earthers are no exception.

cues.zh: 想想你去超市买罐头汤的场景。
cues.en: Just consider going to the supermarket and buying canned soup.

cues.zh: 你有证据证明罐子里的东西能吃吗？
cues.en: Do you have evidence that what’s in the can is edible?

cues.zh: 大概没有。
cues.en: Probably not.

cues.en: For one, the can’s closed.

cues.zh: 如果你和我差不多，你大概完全不知道它是怎么、在哪里、由谁
cues.en: And if you are anything like me, you probably have no idea how or where or by whom it was

cues.zh: 生产出来的。

cues.en: No, because you do have evidence that canned soup is edible.

cues.zh: 你知道你所在国家的法律制度是如何运作的，你知道有相关法规
cues.en: You know how the legal system in your country works, you know that there are regulations

cues.en: on what can be sold as food in a supermarket, you know that if what’s in that can was

cues.en: collected with your own sense, because what else could you possibly have collected it

cues.zh: 来收集呢？
cues.en: with?

cues.en: Now let’s come back to flat earthers.

cues.zh: 你们大多数人都没有物理学学位，而且很可能在上学时学过
cues.en: Most of you don’t have a physics degree and chances are that after learning in school

cues.en: how we know the earth is round you didn’t think much about it ever again.

cues.zh: 大体上你可能坚信这是对的，因为你在学校学到的内容
cues.en: By and large you are probably confident it’s correct because what you learned in school

cues.zh: 合情合理，而且你知道所有小孩普遍都是这么教的，并且你知道政府
cues.en: was plausible, and you know it is widely taught to children, and you know that your government

cues.zh: 也在努力为本国儿童提供符合科学常识的教育。
cues.en: strives to give children in your country a scientifically accurate education.

cues.zh: 所以你完全有理由认为，自己学到的知识背后是有坚实科学
cues.en: So you have good reason to think the knowledge you were taught is backed by solid scientific

cues.zh: 依据支撑的。
cues.en: evidence.

cues.zh: 这并不属于诉诸权威。
cues.en: There is no appealing to authority here.

cues.zh: 关于社会是如何运转的，这些证据全都是你自己收集来的。
cues.en: You have totally yourself collected all this evidence about how society works.

cues.zh: 而且你个人也收集了大量证据，证明科学确实行之有效。
cues.en: You have also yourself collected lots of evidence that science works.

cues.zh: 任何飞机、任何笔记本电脑、任何一副眼镜，都是科学有效的证据。
cues.en: Any airplane, any laptop, any pair of glasses is evidence that science works.

cues.en: It’s evidence that the system works.

cues.en: So, if you cannot recall just what experiments demonstrate that the earth is not flat, or

cues.en: if you cannot immediately figure out what’s wrong with flat earther’s arguments, there’s

cues.zh: 不必羞愧地拒绝他们的主张，因为你的拒绝是基于证据的，证据
cues.en: no shame in rejecting their claims, because your rejection is based on evidence, evidence

cues.zh: 就是科学有效。
cues.en: that science works.

cues.zh: 问题在于，地平说支持者声称他们在进行一场科学论证。
cues.en: What’s wrong is that flat earthers’ claim they are leading a scientific argument.

cues.zh: 但关于地球是不是平的，根本不存在什么科学论证。
cues.en: But there is no scientific argument about whether the earth is flat.

cues.zh: 这个争论早就尘埃落定了。
cues.en: This argument was settled long ago.

cues.zh: 相反，地平说支持者的论点，其实是关于你该不该相信
cues.en: Instead, flat earthers’ argument is about whether you should trust evidence that other

cues.zh: 别人在你之前收集的证据。
cues.en: people have collected before you.

cues.zh: 这是一个重要的论点，因为这种信任对社会和科学的发展至关重要
cues.en: And it’s an important argument because this trust is essential for society and science

cues.zh: 才能不断进步。
cues.en: to progress.

cues.zh: 我们唯一的选择就是每个人从出生起
cues.en: The only alternative we have is that each and every one of us has to start over from

cues.zh: 都得从头开始。
cues.en: scratch with birth.

cues.en: You see, flat earthers would eventually figure out the earth is round.

cues.zh: 但要等他们重新发明现代科学，可能得花上一千年。
cues.en: But it might take them a thousand years until they’ve reinvented modern science.

cues.zh: 所以我认为，科学家应该认真对待地平说者提出的哲学问题。
cues.en: This is why I think scientists should take flat earthers’ philosophical problem seriously.

cues.zh: 任何科学发达的社会都必须解决这个问题。
cues.en: It’s a problem that any scientifically advanced society must address.

cues.zh: 我们不可能每个人都重新做一遍科学史上的所有实验
cues.en: It is not possible for each and every one of us to redo all experiments in the history
of science.

cues.zh: 因此，科学家提供证据说明科学是如何
cues.en: It therefore becomes increasingly important that scientists provide evidence for how science

cues.zh: 运作的，就变得越来越重要。这样，无法理解研究本身的人，也能依靠证据
cues.en: works, so that people who cannot follow the research itself can instead rely on evidence

cues.zh: 相信这套体系能够对自然作出准确而有用的描述。
cues.en: that the system produces correct and useful descriptions of nature.

cues.zh: 因此，在我看来，地平说者是一个警示信号，科学家应该认真对待。
cues.en: To me, therefore, flat earthers, are a warning sign that scientists should take seriously.

cues.zh: 非专业人士越难理解科学实验和论证，
cues.en: The more difficult scientific experiments and arguments are to follow for non-experts,

cues.zh: 我们就越要认真解释这些论证是如何得出的。
cues.en: the more care we must take to explain how we lead those arguments.

cues.zh: 感谢你听我讲，下周见。
